final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* reference sink / NMOS bias
MB0 ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=2.5 L=1
* tail current source (160 uA)
MT  tail ibias vss vss nfet W=2.5 L=1 m=16
* NMOS input pair
M1  fa vinp tail vss nfet W=5 L=0.5 m=20
M2  fb vinn tail vss nfet W=5 L=0.5 m=20
* PMOS bias generation
MB1 pb ibias vss vss nfet W=2.5 L=1
MP0 pb pb vdd vdd pfet W=8 L=1
* PMOS folding current sources (100 uA each)
M3  fa pb vdd vdd pfet W=8 L=1 m=10
M4  fb pb vdd vdd pfet W=8 L=1 m=10
* PMOS cascode bias vcp = VDD - VSG - 0.3V
MP2 x1 x1 vdd vdd pfet W=8 L=1
R1  x1 vcp 30k
MB2 vcp ibias vss vss nfet W=2.5 L=1
* NMOS cascode bias vcn = VGS + 0.3V
MP1 vcn pb vdd vdd pfet W=8 L=1
R2  vcn x2 30k
MB3 x2 x2 vss vss nfet W=2.5 L=1
* PMOS cascodes (own n-well, bulk = source)
M5  nl   vcp fa fa pfet W=12 L=0.5
M6  vout vcp fb fb pfet W=12 L=0.5
* NMOS wide-swing cascode mirror load
M7  nl   vcn y1 vss nfet W=4 L=0.5
M8  vout vcn y2 vss nfet W=4 L=0.5
M9  y1 nl vss vss nfet W=2.5 L=1 m=2
M10 y2 nl vss vss nfet W=2.5 L=1 m=2
.ends
